scaleme.midnightconfig.title: ScaleMe
scaleme.midnightconfig.handDesc: Master switch for all held item customisation. Both arm position and item transform are controlled by this toggle.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableHandItemTra:
Turns on all held item customisation below. Disable this to restore the default Minecraft look entirely.

Controls:
• Arm Base Position (where your hand sits on screen)
• Item Transform (size, offset, rotation on top of that)
• Off-Hand variants of both
scaleme.midnightconfig.armPosDesc: Arm Base Position — replaces the vanilla anchor point where your hand sits on screen
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableArmPosition: Override Arm Base Position  [requires Master ON]

Replaces the fixed point Minecraft uses to place your hand on screen.

Vanilla values: X 0.56 · Y -0.52 · Z -0.72 · Height Scale -0.6

The Item Transform sliders below are applied on top of this — change this first if the item feels wrong in general, then use Item Transform to fine-tune.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseX.tooltip:
How far right your hand sits on screen. Vanilla is 0.56.
The Item Transform 'Move Left/Right' slider shifts the item relative to this point.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseY.tooltip:
How far down your hand sits on screen. Vanilla is -0.52.
The Item Transform 'Move Up/Down' slider shifts the item relative to this point.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseZ.tooltip:
How far in front of you your hand sits. Vanilla is -0.72.
The Item Transform 'Move Closer/Further' slider shifts the item relative to this point.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armHeightScale.to:
How much your hand moves down as it raises up during the equip/lower animation.
Vanilla is -0.6. Set to 0 to pin the item at a fixed Y regardless of hand height.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableItemTransfo:
Enables the size, position, and rotation sliders below.
The item will render at its default position unless this is ON.

Note: Arm Base Position and Item Transform are independent — you can use either or both.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTransformDesc: Item Transform — offset applied on top of the arm anchor
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemScale.tooltip:
How big or small the item in your hand appears.
Smaller values make it tiny, larger values make it huge.
Shifts the item in your hand to the left or right relative to the arm anchor.
Negative values move it left, positive values move it right.
Shifts the item in your hand up or down relative to the arm anchor.
Negative values move it down, positive values move it up.
Shifts the item in your hand closer to or further from your screen relative to the arm anchor.
Negative values push it away, positive values bring it closer.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationX.too: Tilts the item in your hand up or down.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationY.too: Rotates the item in your hand to the left or right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationZ.too: Spins the item in your hand clockwise or counterclockwise.
scaleme.midnightconfig.offhandDesc:
Off-Hand — requires 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' to be ON
Has its own arm anchor and item transform. When disabled, off-hand uses the main hand values for everything.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableSeparateHan: Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform  [requires Master ON]

Allows the off-hand to use different arm anchor and item transform values from the main hand.
When OFF, all off-hand sliders below are ignored and the main hand values apply to both hands.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseXOffhand.t:
Same as main hand Arm Anchor X but for the off-hand.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON and 'Override Arm Base Position' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseYOffhand.t:
Same as main hand Arm Anchor Y but for the off-hand.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON and 'Override Arm Base Position' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseZOffhand.t:
Same as main hand Arm Anchor Z but for the off-hand.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON and 'Override Arm Base Position' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armHeightScaleOff:
Same as main hand Height Bob Scale but for the off-hand.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON and 'Override Arm Base Position' is ON.
How big or small the off-hand item appears.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationXO:
Shifts the off-hand item to the left or right relative to its arm anchor.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationYO:
Shifts the off-hand item up or down relative to its arm anchor.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationZO:
Shifts the off-hand item closer to or further from your screen relative to its arm anchor.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationXOffh:
Tilts the off-hand item up or down.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationYOffh:
Rotates the off-hand item to the left or right.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationZOffh:
Spins the off-hand item clockwise or counterclockwise.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is ON.
scaleme.midnightconfig.animDesc: Master switch for all animation customisation. Swing speed, shape, and bobbing are all controlled by this toggle.
Lets you hold right-click with a sword to enter a blocking pose, similar to pre-1.9.
The keybind defaults to right mouse button — rebind it in Controls if needed.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableAnimOverrid:
Turns on all custom animation settings below. Disable this to keep the default Minecraft swing animations entirely.

Controls:
• Swing bobbing suppression
• Swing speed and speed effect ignoring
• Disable swing animation entirely
• Custom Swing Shape (arc and drift sliders)
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingBobbi: Stop Item Bobbing While Swinging (This overrides Arm Height Bob Scale)

Prevents the item from bouncing up and down when you swing it.
Vanilla bobs the item based on your attack strength cooldown. This locks it steady.
scaleme.midnightconfig.ignoreSwingSpeedE:
Potion effects like Haste or Mining Fatigue will no longer change how fast your arm swings.
The swing will always use the base duration set by the Swing Speed slider.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingAnimationSpe:
How fast your arm swings when you attack or use an item.
Lower values slow it down, higher values speed it up.

If 'Ignore Speed Effects' is ON, this runs on the base 6-tick duration.
If OFF, it multiplies whatever duration Haste/Fatigue would give you.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingAnima:
Completely removes the arm swing animation. Your arm stays still when you click.
Overrides all swing shape settings below.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableSwingOverri:
Turns on the custom swing arc and drift sliders below, replacing the vanilla swing shape entirely.
Disable this to keep the default Minecraft swing arc while still using speed or bobbing changes above.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmXScale.to:
How much the item moves left/right during a swing.
Vanilla is -0.4, which lunges the item toward the center of the screen. Set to 0 to remove this.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmYScale.to:
How much the item bobs up and down during a swing.
Vanilla is 0.2. Set to 0 to remove the vertical movement entirely.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmZScale.to:
How much the item pushes toward the screen during a swing.
Vanilla is -0.2. Set to 0 to stop the item launching forward.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmXMultiply: Mirror Drift X for Left Hand

When ON, the X drift is flipped for the off-hand so it mirrors the main hand.
This matches vanilla behaviour. Turn OFF for identical drift direction on both hands.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingPreRotationY:
The Y angle the item is rotated to before the swing arc begins.
Vanilla is 45°. Lower values keep the item more face-on at the start of the swing.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcYAmount.t:
How many degrees the item rotates around Y during the swing arc.
Vanilla is -20°. Negative rotates left, positive rotates right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcZAmount.t:
How many degrees the item tilts sideways during the swing arc.
Vanilla is -20°.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcXAmount.t:
How many degrees the item swings downward during an attack.
This is the main downward chop. Vanilla is -80°. Set closer to 0 to reduce the downward arc.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingCounterRotat:
When ON, the pre-rotation is undone after the arc, swinging the item back toward the center of the screen. This is vanilla behaviour.
Turn OFF to keep the item at its pre-rotated angle throughout the swing, similar to 1.8.
scaleme.midnightconfig.scaleDesc: Adjust the size of players and entities in the world
scaleme.midnightconfig.scaleNameTags.too:
Makes name tags scale with the entity instead of staying fixed at 1.0x size.
Affects all entities that have a visible name tag.
scaleme.midnightconfig.playerScale.toolt:
Changes how big or small your own character appears to others.
Does not affect your own first-person view.
scaleme.midnightconfig.otherPlayersScale: Changes how big or small other players appear to you.
Changes how big or small villager NPCs appear.
scaleme.midnightconfig.hypixelNpcScale.t:
Changes how big or small Hypixel NPCs appear.
Only has an effect when playing on Hypixel.
scaleme.midnightconfig.viewDescription: Control your crosshair and camera behaviour
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableCrosshairIn: Shows the crosshair when the camera is behind your character.
Shows the crosshair when the camera is facing your character from the front.
Removes the option to flip the camera to face your character.
scaleme.midnightconfig.showOwnNametagInT: Show Own Nametag in Third Person
Shows your own nametag when you are in third person.
scaleme.midnightconfig.hidePlayers.toolt: Prevents other players from rendering in the world. Does not affect yourself.
scaleme.midnightconfig.hidePlayersOnlyOn: When enabled, the Hide Players option only takes effect while on Hypixel Skyblock.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemDesc: Change the size of items lying on the ground
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableGroundItemS: Turns on the slider below so you can make dropped items bigger or smaller.
scaleme.midnightconfig.groundItemScale.t: How big or small dropped items appear in the world. 1.0 is vanilla size.
